name: greylocalrag MCP registry template
note: Portable seed copied by bin/greylocalrag to ~/.greylocalrag/agent/mcp_registry.json on first launch only (the copy never overwrites). These carry the deb install-root paths from scripts/package_deb.sh: the deb installs the frozen tree at /opt/greylocalrag. On the dev tree the seeding is skipped because the home registry already exists.

servers.name: memory
servers.note: The fork's designed memory surface: hot/cold tiers, per-row tolerant reads, cold-md covered, bad-args surface as errors. Store at ~/.greylocalrag/memory.

servers.name: knowledge
servers.note: The fork-owned RAG surface (tools rag_status/rag_search/rag_ingest_pdf/rag_ingest_urls/rag_ingest_text/rag_remove/rag_list_sources) over the fork KB at ~/.greylocalrag/dbs; rag_remove refuses without confirm and stages pending-remove.json.

servers.name: greysearch
servers.note: The fork-owned public searxng lane (tools search/search_health), keyless, no private-tree dependency.
